title: Effectiveness of Recovery Protocols Combination in Soccer Players
brief_summary: The main objective of this project is to compare the effectiveness of combining different recovery methods on perceptual and physical performance on soccer players.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* semi-professional soccer players
* 75 minutes game participation (minimum)
* 5 years of experience practicing soccer

Exclusion Criteria:

* goalkeepers
* injured players
